journal_lines: §aHollow behind the wall. §oSmelled like nothing — no stone-smell, no damp, just absence.§o Geode. §lAmethyst§l inside.
§aPurple light from a crack in the deepslate. Opened it carefully.
§aChimed when the pick touched it. §oA high note, then a lower one.§o Amethyst cluster, full geode.
§aCrystal points everywhere inside. Worked the edges. Left the center intact.
§aThe hollow smelled still in a way moving air never does. §lAmethyst§l geode, well-formed.
§aSmall crack in the stone that widened into a chamber. Purple all the way around inside.
§aCold in the paw — colder than the surrounding rock. §lAmethyst§l always is.
§aTook the loose clusters. §oThey rang against each other in the bag, soft as a bell wrapped in cloth.§o
§aGeode opened on the third strike. Not small. Worked it for a while.
§aPurple points the size of a claw tip. Hundreds of them. Took what the bag could hold.
§aNoticed the tone the stone made when I tapped it. Hollow. Dug in. Found the geode.
§aClusters growing off clusters inside. §lAmethyst§l, deep and well-lit by its own colour.
